nom: medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Gel Mask

avis.titre: Love the results, wish the mask was a bit larger
avis.texte: The results for me were fabulous. The instructions say to apply to CLEAN skin and to wear for 1-3 hours (NOT overnight as people are posting on social media, and NOT after applying other serums as some social media/YouTube influencers advise, which might explain the skin irritation some users describe in the negative reviews here and elsewhere). My only "con" is that the mask appears to have been designed for a demographic whose foreheads are of lesser height. While I was able to make snips so that the mask laid flat against the skin at the outer corners of my eyes and the bridge of my nose, no amount of manipulation will ever cover the 1.25" gap at the top of my forehead. Next time I will also snip along the green lines, so that the nostril segments can be used to fill in the gaps on my inner cheeks.

avis.titre: Use as Directed for best results!
avis.texte: I love these masks so much! They make your skin soft and glowy for days after. Any of these reviews that say they were burned or red seem to be leaving them on for much too long. Only leave it on until it turns from pink to opaque. Repurchase always!!

avis.titre: do NOT recommend - caused chemical burns
avis.texte: DO NOT USE THESE. Bought them last week and used one at night, as directed. Woke up with redness on my cheeks, around my nose, mouth and chin - turns out they were CHEMICAL BURNS from these masks. Spots were super tender so I only applied moisturizer after and a few hours later, all spots were super dry with flaky skin. I did not have dry skin prior to using this mask, nor did I use any products that would counteract with the masks (I triple checked ingredients). This was 4 days ago and the burns have not gone away, the dryness is even worse (even with moisturizer multiple times a day) and I now have deep, painful acne along my jaw - sometime I have not suffered from in over 5 years. Read many other reviews about these masks and many user report the same thing. Disappointing, hoping my skin heals soon and I will be bringing these back for a refund ASAP.
